description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class EmployeeSubordinateSearchFilterParams used to encapsulate filtering parameters for subordinate employee searches within the OrangeHRM system. It includes a property for employee number and sets default sorting by subordinate's last name.

classes.name: EmployeeSubordinateSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for subordinate employee search filters, extending the base FilterParams class. It allows setting and retrieving an employee number and defaults sorting by subordinate's last name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters and sets default sort field to 'subordinate.lastName'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter criterion, or null if not set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.
